Nina (CSM): Heads-up: Hearthly org token usage down ~65% week-over-week. New PM (Ava) copied on a procurement note asking about TCO. Can we triage? https://dash.redwood/usage?org=hearthly :rotating_light:
usage-bot: Alert: hearthly usage drop 65% in 7d window. Rule: sudden-decline.
Marco (AE): saw this. We did a success review last month. Ava, any context from your side? Are they running any pilot with another vendor?
Ava (Hearthly PM): Hi all, we put some jobs on hold while finance double-checks monthly spend. Also getting a shortlist from procurement that includes FalconAI. No formal decision yet.
Priya (SE): quick check on our side: I see a spike in 429s from their org around Mar 10-12 — looks like client-side throttling hitting them after a burst. Sample log:
```
2026-03-12T09:22:14Z WARN client 429 rate_limit_exceeded org=hearthly service=redwood-api
2026-03-12T09:22:15Z ERROR request dropped id=xyz789
```
Could be a batching change on their end or not handling backpressure.
Derek (PM): small release (v2.7.1) changed default concurrency cap to 10 from 40 last week to protect shared pools. That might surface as client throttles for heavy integrations. Change note: `v2.7.1: reduced default downstream concurrency for safety`.
Marco (AE): ok cost + procurement + 3rd-party shortlist = potential renewal risk. Nina, can you set up a quick joint review with finance and the new PM? I'll ask for competitor names and pricing bands in advance.
Nina (CSM): proposed plan: 1) 20m debugging session with Hearthly ops + SE to confirm throttling cause 2) SE to run a cost demo (batching + caching) showing expected TCO delta 3) AE to capture competitive shortlist and ask for decision criteria 4) pre-write a 1-pager for Renewal Ops if risk persists.
Priya (SE): workaround for immediate unblocking: increase client-side retries and exponential backoff; if they can bump connections to use a connection pool and set timeout=45 it reduces observed 429s. Example client change:
```
client = RedwoodClient(timeout=45, max_concurrency=20, retries="exponential")
```
Marco (AE): I'll lead the commercial touchpoint. Nina, schedule the call. Also flag Legal (Sam) if they ask for credits or a concession.
Sam (Legal): noted. Happy to join if they request contract or SOW adjustments.
usage-bot: Meeting created: hearthly-renewal-triage 2026-03-13 15:30 UTC (attendees: Nina, Marco, Priya, Ava)
Ava (Hearthly PM): thanks — we'll gather finance and provide the shortlist before the call. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Nina (CSM): Task list recorded. Priya to verify repro + demo, Marco to collect competitor intel, Derek to confirm rollback toggle for concurrency if needed, Nina to send the exec summary afterwards. Will escalate to renewal-watch if usage stays low after the sync. :pray:
